content.short: BNB Chain provides one of the largest blockchains in terms of transaction volume and daily active users.
content.description: BNB Chain is a community-driven, open-source, and decentralized ecosystem. In February 2022, Binance merged the Binance Smart Chain and the Binance Chain to form the BNB Chain, a network that preserves Ethereum Virtual Machine compatibility while expanding into a true multi-chain hub. It ranks among the world's largest cryptocurrency ecosystems, with the native token BNB holding third place by market cap at roughly $40.9 billion (excluding stablecoins), reflecting broad adoption and ongoing development across its chain network.
